operational_boundary: Restricted to Human-in-the-Loop Assistive Mode. Automated public life-safety sirens prohibited until balanced convective retraining.

criteria.requirement: FastAPI REST backend starts cleanly, initializes dependencies, and exposes required operational endpoints
criteria.evidence: api_server:app initializes successfully; /health, /live, /ready, and /api/radar-grid return HTTP 200
criteria.known_limitation: Single ASGI worker process in dev; requires Uvicorn worker pool for high concurrency

criteria.requirement: React/Vite 3D WebGL Globe frontend builds cleanly and renders multi-layer nowcast visualizations
criteria.evidence: frontend/dist built via tsc -b && vite build (2.9 MB bundle); 3D Globe renders GeoJSON districts and radar heatmap
criteria.known_limitation: Three.js Globe requires WebGL2 capable hardware; falls back to 2D view on legacy browsers

criteria.requirement: Zero hardcoded production secrets committed to version control; secret masking in structured logs
criteria.evidence: Git search confirmed no private keys or .env.production committed; StructuredJSONFormatter redacts Bearer tokens and API keys
criteria.known_limitation: Development .env files exist locally for tests but are gitignored
criteria.remediation_required: Enforce pre-commit hook scanning on all developer workstations

criteria.requirement: Automated regression test suite covers data pipelines, monitoring, reliability, and deployment
criteria.evidence: 64 of 64 tests pass cleanly in 50.86s across test_phase9, test_phase10, test_phase11, test_phase12
criteria.known_limitation: Tests utilize fast local SQLite and CPU tensors; end-to-end multi-hour soak tests run separately
criteria.remediation_required: Schedule automated nightly soak test on staging server

criteria.requirement: Multi-cadence ingestion adapters operational for Radar, Satellite, Lightning, and NWP feeds
criteria.evidence: Adapters operational for IMD (10m), INSAT-3D (15m), Blitzortung (streaming), and Open-Meteo (1h)
criteria.known_limitation: Upstream IMD radar APIs experience intermittent rate limiting and downtime during severe weather
criteria.remediation_required: Negotiate dedicated IMD push feed / FTP mirror for operational deployment

criteria.requirement: Strict isolation prohibiting synthetic simulation data from masquerading as real observations in production
criteria.evidence: DeploymentConfig.validate() raises Fail-Fast ConfigurationError if DATA_MODE=simulation in production
criteria.known_limitation: Hybrid mode allows simulation fallback only when explicitly configured in non-production environments

criteria.requirement: Atmospheric quality control enforces physical boundaries, geographic bounding boxes, and temporal freshness
criteria.evidence: AtmosphericQualityControl validates range checks (dBZ: -10 to 75), India domain bbox, and freshness; rejects unphysical/NaN data
criteria.known_limitation: Biological radar clutter (insects/birds) may require dual-polarization correlation coefficient filtering
criteria.remediation_required: Incorporate dual-pol RhoHV / ZDR filters when polarimetric radar feeds become operational

criteria.requirement: Model artifact registered with immutable cryptographic checksum, metadata, and architecture documentation
criteria.evidence: convlstm_real_best.keras registered in model_registry table with SHA-256 (6194f04a...) and 191,524 parameters
criteria.known_limitation: TensorFlow graph loaded in eager/XLA mode; ONNX / TensorRT runtime not yet built
criteria.remediation_required: Export ONNX / TensorRT weights for edge embedded deployments

criteria.requirement: Model warmup and numerical verification prevents runtime panics and invalid tensor outputs
criteria.evidence: ModelWarmupEngine passes synthetic fixture on boot (latency 59.36 ms); NumericalSafetyValidator rejects NaNs
criteria.known_limitation: Warmup increases container cold start time by ~900 ms

criteria.requirement: Strict separation between synthetic development validation, real-world historical validation, and operational validation
criteria.evidence: Documentation and codebase strictly separate procedural synthetic benchmarks (128 samples) from real historical ERA5/IMD dataset (2,648 samples)
criteria.known_limitation: Historical dataset size (464 training samples) remains small due to limited open Doppler radar archives
criteria.remediation_required: Acquire 3-5 full convective seasons of IMD radar volume scans for model v2.0 retraining

criteria.requirement: Demonstrated forecast skill at operational convective thresholds (25 dBZ, 35 dBZ, 45 dBZ) on unseen real-world data
criteria.evidence: On unseen real test set (2,648 sequences), model achieves CSI=0.0 and POD=0.0 at 35 dBZ due to severe class imbalance and underprediction
criteria.known_limitation: Convective storm samples constituted < 1.5% of real training set; network converged to background clear-air prediction
criteria.remediation_required: Apply extreme convective oversampling, focal loss, and retrain on storm-curated episodes before public alerting

criteria.requirement: Baseline comparison against Persistence, Climatology, and Simple Extrapolation on identical test periods
criteria.evidence: Model achieves lower continuous MAE (0.467 dBZ) than persistence (0.512 dBZ), but persistence outperforms model on +15m convective CSI (0.021 vs 0.000)
criteria.known_limitation: Neural network smoothing diminishes convective peak reflectivity compared to persistence advection
criteria.remediation_required: Implement blended Nowcaster combining optical flow advection for 0-30m with ConvLSTM for 30-60m

criteria.requirement: Independent validation of lightning jump 2-sigma precursor detection against historical convective events
criteria.evidence: 2-sigma lightning jump algorithm successfully flags sudden updraft electrification (> 2.0 sigma surge) within 5-min epochs
criteria.known_limitation: High false alarm rate in non-severe multi-cell clusters; cannot be used as sole criterion without radar VIL confirmation
criteria.remediation_required: Require co-located VIL > 20 kg/m² and cold cloud-top < -45°C before triggering lightning jump alerts

criteria.requirement: System transitions transparently between HEALTHY, DEGRADED, STALE, and NOT_READY states upon component failures
criteria.evidence: Proved in DRILL-001 through DRILL-008; circuit breakers trip cleanly, UI displays explicit degraded indicators
criteria.known_limitation: Degraded mode fallback relies on satellite proxy which has lower spatial resolution (4 km vs 500 m)
criteria.remediation_required: Train operators on interpreting satellite-only degraded mode nowcasts

criteria.requirement: Inference concurrency bounds prevent memory exhaustion under burst traffic
criteria.evidence: InferenceConcurrencyLimiter (max_concurrent=2) successfully queues requests and sheds excess with HTTP 503
criteria.known_limitation: Under sustained load > 16 req/sec, client requests will receive HTTP 503 unless scaled horizontally
criteria.remediation_required: Deploy backend with multi-worker autoscaling if public user traffic exceeds 10,000 DAU

criteria.requirement: OWASP security headers enforced across all responses; payload size strictly limited
criteria.evidence: X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and X-XSS-Protection active; 10 MB payload limiter active
criteria.known_limitation: HSTS header omitted in development environment; active in production

criteria.requirement: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) protects administrative endpoints from unauthorized invocation
criteria.evidence: Unauthorized POST to /api/system/model-registry/promote rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden
criteria.known_limitation: Current implementation uses static API tokens; OAuth2/OIDC required for multi-institution federated login
criteria.remediation_required: Integrate Keycloak / OAuth2 OIDC for multi-agency operator logins

criteria.requirement: Online SQLite WAL snapshot backup and automated restoration drill with verified table row parity
criteria.evidence: Automated drill executed with measured RTO of 28.5 ms (target < 15 min), RPO < 1 hour, 100% table row parity across 7 tables
criteria.known_limitation: Backups stored locally on host NVMe; off-site S3 replication required for geographic disaster resilience
criteria.remediation_required: Configure daily rsync / AWS S3 bucket sync for data/backups/ directory

criteria.requirement: Mandatory Human-in-the-Loop oversight for high-impact warnings; model promotion requires operator approval
criteria.evidence: Documented in docs/operations/human_oversight.md; automated siren issuance prohibited; promotion requires explicit ADMIN sign-off
criteria.known_limitation: Requires continuous human staffing during severe weather episodes
criteria.remediation_required: Maintain 24/7 duty forecaster roster during active convective seasons
